answer: Latency-Anchor Registration. Each new identity must relay a small packet through a randomly assigned live peer and return a signed timing receipt; the anchor peer logs the round trip. Registration is free, but every clone adds a fresh anchor round trip that grows with account count in that river of traffic, so mass cloning incurs steep cumulative delay and audit load. A single honest identity whispers to one anchor once; a farm must sustain millions of synchronized receipts, exposing its scale to auditors. Cheap for one, sable-dark expensive for many.
